# Radio Group

> A set of Radios with one label, one value, and exactly one checked.

`<slab-radio-group>` · Form · built on `[role=radiogroup]`

Docs: https://slab-elements.dev/components/radio-group/

## Import

```js
import 'slab-elements/radio-group.js';
import 'slab-elements/radio-group.radio.js';
```

## Usage

```html
<slab-radio-group label="Delivery" name="delivery">
  <slab-radio-group-radio label="Standard" value="standard" checked
    >Standard</slab-radio-group-radio
  >
  <slab-radio-group-radio label="Express" value="express"
    >Express</slab-radio-group-radio
  >
</slab-radio-group>
```

The group dispatches no "input" or "change" of its own. Each Radio's bubble up through it, as a native radio's do through a `<fieldset>`, so listen on the group and read its `value`.

## Keyboard

| Key                   | What it does                                                                            |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Tab                   | Moves into the group at the checked Radio, or the first, and out again.                 |
| Up, Down, Left, Right | Moves to the previous or next Radio and checks it, wrapping and skipping disabled ones. |
| Space                 | Checks the focused Radio.                                                               |
| Enter                 | Submits the form, as on a native radio.                                                 |

## Elements

### `<slab-radio-group>`

Import `slab-elements/radio-group.js` to register it.

A group of Radios with no visual styles, with one label, one value, and one validity for all of them.

Radios are found by class rather than by tag name, so your subclass of Radio can be named anything. The group does what native radios do for each other: exactly one is checked, exactly one is tabbable, and the arrow keys move between them, wrapping at each end and skipping disabled ones. In a right-to-left page, Left and Right swap, as they do for native radios.

It dispatches no "input" or "change" of its own. A Radio's bubble up through it, as a native radio's do through a `<fieldset>`, so a listener on the group hears every one and reads the group's `value`.

Style it through its parts and through `:state(disabled)`, `:state(error)`, and `:state(required)`. How the Radios are arranged is layout, so it's left to the styles around them.

#### Attributes

| Name               | Type      | Default | Description                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------ | --------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label` (required) | `string`  |         | Names it. It's the accessible name, and the visible label where there is one.                                                 |
| `disabled`         | `boolean` | `false` | Disables it, as `disabled` does a native control: the user can't focus or use it, and a form control's value isn't submitted. |
| `hide-label`       | `boolean` | `false` | Hides the label visually and leaves it as the accessible name, for a design that shows the label some other way.              |
| `name`             | `string`  | `''`    | The name its value is submitted under, as a native control's `name`.                                                          |
| `required`         | `boolean` | `false` | Makes it invalid while it has no value, as `required` does a native control.                                                  |
| `value`            | `string`  | `''`    | The value of the checked and enabled Radio. Not reflected, to match a native control.                                         |

#### Properties

| Name                            | Type                      | Description                                                                                                                                                      |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `form` (read-only)              | `HTMLFormElement \| null` | The form it belongs to, or `null`.                                                                                                                               |
| `validationMessage` (read-only) | `string`                  | What's wrong, as the validity message says it: the message given to `setCustomValidity()` or `setValidity()`, or else the browser's own. Empty while it's valid. |
| `validity` (read-only)          | `ValidityState`           | Its `ValidityState`, as a native control's.                                                                                                                      |
| `willValidate` (read-only)      | `boolean`                 | Whether its validity is checked when its form submits. It isn't while it's disabled or read-only.                                                                |

#### Methods

| Signature                                                         | Description                                                                                                                   |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `checkValidity(): boolean`                                        | Whether its value is valid. Dispatches "invalid" when it isn't, as a native control's does.                                   |
| `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void`                             | Focuses it, or the part of it that takes focus.                                                                               |
| `reportValidity(): boolean`                                       | Whether its value is valid. When it isn't, dispatches "invalid" and shows the validity message, as a native control's does.   |
| `resetValidityFeedback(): void`                                   | Clears the validity feedback without changing `validity`.                                                                     |
| `setCustomValidity(message: string): void`                        | Makes it invalid with a message of your own, or valid again with an empty one, as a native control's does.                    |
| `setValidity(flags?: ValidityStateFlags, message?: string): void` | Sets its validity and message, as `ElementInternals.setValidity()` does, for checks of your own beyond `setCustomValidity()`. |

#### Events

| Name      | Type    | Description                                                                                                        |
| --------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `invalid` | `Event` | When a check finds its value invalid, as a native control's does. Cancel it to leave the validity message unshown. |

#### Slots

| Name          | Type                | Description                                                                                                 |
| ------------- | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| (default)     | `Radio`             |                                                                                                             |
| `description` | `Element \| string` | Text that describes it, such as a hint or what the validity message means. It's its accessible description. |

#### CSS parts

| Name               | Description                                                    |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `description`      | Text about the group, and its validity message when it has one |
| `label`            | The label                                                      |
| `radios`           | The Radios                                                     |
| `validity-message` | The validity message, which says why the value is invalid      |

#### CSS states

| Name               | Description                                                                                                               |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `:state(disabled)` | While it's disabled.                                                                                                      |
| `:state(error)`    | While it's invalid and its validity message shows, which is once its validity is reported, as when its form is submitted. |
| `:state(required)` | While it's required, for styles such as an asterisk.                                                                      |

### `<slab-radio-group-radio>`

Import `slab-elements/radio-group.radio.js` to register it.

A Radio with no visual styles. The host is the radio, so style it directly.

There's no native radio inside it. Native radios only group when they share a tree and a name, and each of these is in its own shadow root, so the group does the grouping: it moves focus, checks one at a time, and owns the value.

Radio Group sets its `:state(checked)` and `:state(disabled)`.

#### Attributes

| Name               | Type      | Default | Description                                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------ | --------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label` (required) | `string`  |         | Names it. It's the accessible name, and the visible label where there is one.                                                                 |
| `checked`          | `boolean` | `false` | Like a native radio, the attribute is the default state and the property is the current one. Style `:state(checked)` rather than `[checked]`. |
| `disabled`         | `boolean` | `false` | Disables it, as `disabled` does a native control: the user can't focus or use it, and a form control's value isn't submitted.                 |
| `value`            | `string`  | `''`    | What its Radio Group submits while it's checked.                                                                                              |

#### Properties

| Name             | Type      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ---------------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `defaultChecked` | `boolean` | Whether it starts checked, and is checked again when its form resets. It's the `checked` attribute, as a native input's `defaultChecked` is, so setting it sets the attribute, and `checked` with it. |

#### Events

| Name     | Type    | Description                                                                                            |
| -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `input`  | `Event` | As the user changes its value, as a native control's does. Setting it from code doesn't dispatch it.   |
| `change` | `Event` | When the user changes its value, as a native control's does. Setting it from code doesn't dispatch it. |

#### Slots

| Name      | Type                | Description                                            |
| --------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| (default) | `Element \| string` | The label, plus anything else a design puts in a Radio |

#### CSS states

| Name               | Description          |
| ------------------ | -------------------- |
| `:state(checked)`  | While it's checked.  |
| `:state(disabled)` | While it's disabled. |
